snippet.title: Embers of the UncrownedㅣInside the Game : Companion & House System
snippet.description:
Lead Eslyn and your followers to rebuild the fallen House of Harborwell. 
Deploy your followers to develop and expand your settlement, and forge your own strategy through dynamic combat alongside your compelling companion, Eslyn.

A playable demo arrives soon. 
Add to your Steam Wishlist to be the first to know.

Learn more: 
🎮 Steam Wishlist: https://nexon.link/bpV
💬 Discord: https://nexon.link/bpZ
💌 X : https://nexon.link/bpY
🌐 Official Site: https://nexon.link/bpE
